items.chunk: When was the last time you…?
items.meaning: 你上次……是什么时候？；关心／了解近况
items.quote: When was the last time you ate?

items.meaning: 起来走走、活动一下
items.quote: Come on, Chuck, let's go over to novi's and stretch our legs, get some air, couple of hoagies.

items.meaning: 只是提个想法；不强求
items.quote: Just a thought.

items.meaning: 替某人收拾残局／善后；此处家人常替 Jimmy 收拾
items.quote: I just remember the whole family cleaning up after you. And mom leaving her own birthday party to drive one of them home.

items.meaning: 另放在一边；点餐时说酱料分开
items.quote: Roast beef, no tomato, Italian on the side?

items.meaning: 所以就到这一步了？；面对最终结果
items.quote: So this is it, then?

items.meaning: 她去世了；委婉告知死讯
items.quote: She's gone.

items.meaning: 稍等一下
items.quote: Yeah, hold on... Hold on one second.

items.meaning: 你能听见吗／还有意识吗？；急救场景
items.quote: Hey, Chuck, you with us buddy?

items.meaning: 撑住／稍等；安抚口语
items.quote: Hang tight, Charles, we're almost there.

items.meaning: 借过！；推着人或物经过
items.quote: Coming through.

items.meaning: 数到三一起行动；协调动作
items.quote: On three. One, two, three.

items.meaning: 失去意识；医疗搭配
items.quote: witnessed by an employee. Estimated loss of consciousness is one minute. His vitals are stable. He's got a laceration to his forehead that appears to need suturing.

items.meaning: 生命体征平稳；医疗搭配
items.quote: His vitals are stable.

items.meaning: 正在服药；就诊用语
items.quote: Are you on any medications?

items.meaning: 患有某种病症／特殊健康状况
items.quote: No! You don't understand. I have a condition. Charles... I have a hypersensitivity to electricity.

items.meaning: 表示同意／授权；医疗法律语境
items.quote: I did not give you my consent. You have no right to do this. You can't touch this.

items.chunk: have no right to do sth.
items.meaning: 没有权利做某事；抗议
items.quote: You have no right to do this. You can't touch this.

items.meaning: 抽血；医疗搭配
items.quote: Draw a little bit of blood, suture up your wound, and do a very simple cat scan.

items.meaning: 按住某人不让动
items.quote: Can you hold him down? Restrain him.

items.chunk: We can't know for sure until…
items.meaning: 在……之前无法确定；说明判断条件
items.quote: I'd love to be able to tell you, but we can't know for sure until we do those tests.

items.chunk: what sb. wants and what sb. needs
items.meaning: 某人想要的与真正需要的；对照骨架
items.quote: He doesn't want to be here. What he wants and what he needs are two very different things, Jimmy.

items.meaning: 符合条件／标准；正式
items.quote: I mean, he fits the parameters.

items.meaning: 干等着某个程序完成
items.quote: You're telling me he's in need of medical care so urgent that we can't wait around on court procedures.

items.meaning: 视检查结果及治疗而定；正式限定
items.quote: Pending results and proper treatment, yes.

items.chunk: Let me be the one to tell him.
items.meaning: 由我亲自告诉他；主动承担谈话
items.quote: Let me be the one to tell him.

items.meaning: 总能立刻出现／随叫随到的人；旧式口语，此处挖苦
items.quote: Well, if it isn't Johnny-on-the-spot. What? What does that mean?

items.meaning: 时而清醒时而失去意识；此处形容意识状态
items.quote: I'd say maybe about a minute? You were, kind of, in and out.

items.meaning: 只有一种可能／解释……；推断
items.quote: There's only one way you could have gotten there so quickly. You never left.

items.meaning: 情绪紧绷、激动起来；口语
items.quote: I think you're getting all wound-up. Can you just take a few deep breaths?

items.meaning: 以我为代价／拿我取乐；此处指嘲笑
items.quote: Just wanted to have a laugh at my expense? I called him.

items.meaning: 说法不同，本质一样；美式口语，对方不接受区别
items.quote: You're trying to have me committed. No, it's a temporary... Temporary emergency guardianship. Tomato, to-mahto.

items.chunk: have sb. where you want them
items.meaning: 把某人逼到自己想要的处境／控制住
items.quote: You've finally got me where you want me.

items.meaning: 看起来累坏了；口语
items.quote: Hey. You look beat.

items.meaning: 一心想整某人／找某人麻烦
items.quote: it's like, he's really out to get you, Jimmy.

items.meaning: 首先不要伤害病人；医学伦理格言
items.quote: Primum non nocere. "First do no harm."

items.meaning: 就好像……；通过类比说明处境
items.quote: It's as though I had an allergy to penicillin, and yet you persist on treating my infection with it.

items.meaning: 坚持继续做某事；常带批评
items.quote: and yet you persist on treating my infection with it.

items.meaning: 类比贴切／适用；此处医生否认其类比
items.quote: I appreciate the analogy, Charles, but I don't think it quite fits.

items.chunk: in and out of a place
items.meaning: 很快去一趟就出来；别与意识时断时续的 in and out 混淆
items.quote: We'll have you in and out of radiology before you know it, all right?

items.meaning: 转眼就好／很快；安抚
items.quote: We'll have you in and out of radiology before you know it, all right?

items.meaning: 看看能否安排／处理某事
items.quote: Then we can see about getting that neck collar off and get you moving around.

items.meaning: 还没消息吗？；等待结果
items.quote: Still no word?

items.meaning: 从头再来
items.quote: Maybe they had to start over.

items.meaning: 谁知道还要多久……；表达不耐烦
items.quote: Would you get your work out, please? Because god knows how much longer we're gonna be here. I'd feel better if you were doing something, you know, unhospitaly.

items.meaning: 我这就去办；接受任务
items.quote: I'm on it.

items.meaning: 询问最新进展
items.quote: You know what? I'm going to go ask for an update.

items.meaning: 依靠／信赖某人
items.quote: someone you can trust, a man who says what he does and does what he says. When you need someone to count on...

items.meaning: 供应不足／如今很少见
items.quote: Because moxie is in such short supply these days.

items.meaning: 好消息是……；先报积极结果
items.quote: So how is he? The good news is that physically, he's okay.

items.chunk: I'm sure that's no surprise to you.
items.meaning: 想必你对此不会惊讶；借已知情况解释
items.quote: I'm sure that's no surprise to you.

items.meaning: 我目前最合理的判断是……；保留不确定性
items.quote: As far as losing consciousness, my best guess is Charles had what's called a stress-related syncope.

items.meaning: 药效／影响逐渐消退
items.quote: Whatever you gave him should've worn off already, right? We watched him for several hours and we even gave him what's called a reversal agent. So, yes, the sedative wore off.

items.chunk: It's just a matter of time before…
items.meaning: ……只是时间问题
items.quote: I have to believe that it's just a matter of time before he comes out of it. Matter of time.

items.meaning: 紧／准到不能再紧／准；as adj. as they come 加强最高程度
items.quote: It's about how tight she shoots. And this one's tight as they come.

items.meaning: 最后还有一件事；补充提问
items.quote: Uh... one last thing...

items.meaning: 没关系，我没觉得被冒犯；回应 no offense
items.quote: No offence. None taken.

items.meaning: 恢复意识／醒过来；此处急救
items.quote: Chuck! Hey, buddy, you're back with us.

items.meaning: 我昏迷／失去意识多久？
items.quote: How long was I out for?

items.meaning: 你该做的都做了；此处请对方离开
items.quote: You've done your duty. You can go now.

items.chunk: That came out a bit harsh.
items.meaning: 刚才那话说重了；即时修正语气
items.quote: That came out a bit harsh. Hmm.

items.meaning: 被反复检查、摆弄；看病时抱怨
items.quote: Look, I've been zapped and poked and prodded, and now I just...

items.meaning: 想一个人待着／不受打扰
items.quote: I want to be left alone.

items.meaning: 事情变糟／出问题
items.quote: If things start going south for you again, how am I even gonna know?

items.meaning: 顺道探望、看看某人情况
items.quote: You need someone looking in on you. You got to eat, right?

items.meaning: 工作／队伍积压；此处客户在等待
items.quote: Folks, I am sorry about the wait. But the attention I give each client means sometimes things get a little... ...backed up.

items.meaning: 依次、一个接一个
items.quote: But I promise to get to each and every one of you, in turn.

items.meaning: 紧急事务；这里是紧迫的法律工作
items.quote: Unfortunately, uh, my associate tells me I'm needed for some brief but pressing legal business.

items.meaning: 与此同时／在这期间
items.quote: I just need to make one quick phone call. Uh, in the meantime who was it who wanted coffee?

items.meaning: 回某人的电话
items.quote: Hey, Julie, it's me. Returning Howard's call.

items.chunk: be in the middle of sth.
items.meaning: 正忙着做某事
items.quote: Jimmy, I'm, kind of, in the middle of something right now. Come back later.

items.meaning: 跟我说说怎么回事／让我了解内情；口语
items.quote: What do you say, Chuck? Uh, clue me in?

items.meaning: 从一开始
items.quote: Should've done this from the start.

items.meaning: 休息一下后立刻继续干
items.quote: Five minutes, and then right back at it.

items.meaning: 突然、毫无预兆
items.quote: Regardless, it's, kind of, out of the blue. Don't you think?

items.meaning: 付诸东流／垮掉
items.quote: You're his number one guy. Without you, that whole place goes down the drain.

items.meaning: 怎么突然变成这样？；追问原因
items.quote: What brought this on exactly, Chuck, huh? 'Cause I don't know what you are if you're not a lawyer.

items.chunk: run sb. out of town on a rail
items.meaning: 把某人赶出城／扫地出门；夸张旧式说法
items.quote: Before you run me out of town on a rail, huh? I'll be the only Mcgill carrying the family name.

items.meaning: 延续／代表家族的姓氏
items.quote: I'll be the only Mcgill carrying the family name.

items.meaning: 躲起来；此处指逃避现实
items.quote: Don't just hide out in your...

items.meaning: 作结案陈词；法庭搭配
items.quote: When you're 99, you can drop dead giving closing arguments to judgebot 3,000,

items.meaning: 完全彻底地；强调
items.quote: I blew it! Completely and utterly.

items.meaning: 把事情搞砸；口语
items.quote: I blew it! Completely and utterly. And then I blamed... And then I blamed you.

items.meaning: 如果我告诉你……呢？；引出反转
items.quote: What if I told you, you didn't make a mistake?

items.chunk: go down exactly like sb. said
items.meaning: 事情完全按某人说的那样发生
items.quote: It all went down exactly like you said. I mean, exactly.

items.meaning: 持续运转／顺利推进；此处比喻大脑仍很好使
items.quote: So you can relax, okay? 'Cause that brain of yours is chugging along at 1,000% efficiency.

items.chunk: I wouldn't be telling you otherwise.
items.meaning: 要不是事实，我不会这么说；加强可信度
items.quote: I sure as shit wouldn't be telling you otherwise. But, yes. It's the truth.

items.chunk: go to such lengths to do sth.
items.meaning: 为了做某事费那么大周折
items.quote: You'd go to such lengths to humiliate me?

items.meaning: 拼命工作；较粗口语
items.quote: What? She worked her butt off to get Mesa Verde,

items.meaning: 坐着消磨时间／什么也不做
items.quote: while you and Howard sat around sipping scotch and chortling.

items.meaning: 一厢情愿的想法
items.quote: Wishful thinking!

items.meaning: 你应该明白／你知道自己……吧；强调后果
items.quote: You do realize you just confessed to a felony.

items.meaning: 各执一词、没有第三方证据；此处说难以证明
items.quote: Besides, it's your word against mine.
